changelog: PHONE FIXES. Commander names and the seed plaque's RANDOM fit their slots instead of running off the edges. The map bar is shorter and fits on one row, and its HQ and Troops numbers sit inside their recesses; the battle bar's numbers do the same, and HOLD and power values no longer overlap their labels. Node hold progress gets a proper plate on the battle bar. Header plaques span the top of narrow menus, and the Achievements header sits above its frame corners. Deployment fixed: in Hold the Center, where your HQ is moved to the middle of the map, the starting tiles now surround where the HQ actually is instead of an empty patch of field. The scouting report on the map now only shows for the nodes you can move to next.
